title: Google Play 2026 年度最佳：Arknights: Endfield、Subway Surfers City 和 Zenless Zone Zero 获奖
content:
Google Play’s best of 2026: Arknights: Endfield, Subway Surfers City and Zenless Zone Zero among winners – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Gryphline’s Arknights: Endfield has been named the best game of 2026 in Google Play’s annual Best of Play awards in every market except Japan and Korea, where the top prize went to Hololive Dreams and Nexon’s MapleStory: Idle RPG, respectively.
Google revealed the winners on November 17 in a
blog post
from Sam Bright, VP and general manager of Google Play and its developer ecosystem.
This year’s picks reflect a shift towards games that span phones, tablets and PCs, he said, and Google singled out Arknights: Endfield’s Sidekick integration and cross-device play via Google Play Games on PC. XSeed Games’ vampire farming sim Moonlight Peaks won best cross-device game in the main list, while Perfect World’s Neverness to Everness took the same award in many Asian markets.
Digital Extremes’ Warframe took best multiplayer game, while Sybo’s Subway Surfers City was named best pick up and play game. Ghost Ship Publishing’s Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor won best indie, Sea of Stars, published on mobile by Playdigious, was named best story, and Mihoyo’s Zenless Zone Zero picked up best ongoing game in the Americas and Europe.
Note-taking app Notability was named best app overall, and Strava won best cross-device app. Google also handed out regional awards in its
Asia Pacific winners list
, including best made in India for Blast+ Games’ Scarfall 2.0 and best made in Indonesia for Own Games’ Tukang Sate VS Ojol Rush.
Arknights: Endfield is also up for best mobile game at
The Game Awards 2026
, where it faces Monster Hunter Outlanders, Neverness to Everness, Pokémon Champions and Where Winds Meet. The winners will be revealed on December 10.
